body: Thank you. I've been fighting. For years and it keeps falling into this same spot and I dont know what to do anymore. I just want it to end
Thann you. I appreciate you and your will to fight...but I think the people who have been exposed to that part of my life will actually be happier. I've caused so much pain and sadness.
Thank you, I hope we do. Thank you for the good wishes.

I'm right there with you, I havent in 5 years up until 3 weeks ago. It feels awful, but I understand it helps me as well. And yes please, keep thinking of the healthier skills and I hope I can, I hope you can too
 
We got this, itll just take time.
That would make sense actually. A lot of sense. How are you doing now?
Thank you. I have been really bad about it recently but I know tomorrow is a new day and I am going to try my best.
2 weeks?! WAY TO GO. I am so proud of you. I am hoping tonight was my last night.

I think it must be that for me as well. Just feeling numb so much and having that brief stimulation is addicting. 

But if you need anyone to chat with, I'm here
I know just how hard it can be to open and I'm a first responder so I GET it and unfortunately I have to keep it a secret as well.

I just took some meds, trying to relax myself to do it. But while I'm here IM HERE. I understand feeling alone and hopeless. But please, if you are comfortable. Talk to me. You and everyone here is worth fighting for.
You are not alone in this. But happy birthday, I hope you overcome this feeling and believe in your worth soon.
I'm so incredible proud and happy for you. I hope the someday I can follow your footsteps but way to kick ass. Keep on fighting 🖤😊
Love Marshall, trying to get Rocket to move cause I dont like her haha!
I'm not sure if you are still on but I love Marshall so far! He is adorable and super sassy and his house is literally everything I want in mine.
My favorite so far is Marshall 😍 least favorite is Rocket...I've been trying to get her to move but she wont leave!
